sources.title: Set up work centers and machine centers (en-US)
sources.appliesTo: Business Central documentation, en-US; checked 2026-09-26
fields: Set up shop calendars before work or machine centers; capacity availability is based on calendars and hierarchy
Work center and machine center capacity, efficiency, routing concurrent capacity, setup/run/wait/move times affect operation duration and lead time
Costing can combine direct unit cost, indirect cost percentage and overhead; verify unit cost calculation basis and resource rates
Alternate work center is informational and is not automatically used by planning; consolidated calendar rolls machine center calendars into work center load
Infinite-capacity scheduling is the default and may overload resources; finite capacity constraints only the configured bottleneck resources and do not provide detailed shop-floor optimization
Flushing settings affect when output is posted; check center defaults and routing-line overrides before processing
